dct_description_sm: This project compared liquid and granular formulations of Fiesta at varying rates to determine pre-emergent/early post-emergent as well as late post-emergent effect on dandelion. Results may be used for registration purposes and marketing in North American markets.
dct_title_s: Replication data for: Final report for Neudorff Fiesta dandelion pre-emergent study – Project # G22-03
